Bounded prep is complete. Summary:

## What I did

**Read-only intake:** `CLAUDE.md`, `cg-journey-probe.mjs` + `lib/cgContract.mjs`, `main/tools/lib/evidence.mjs`, the interim lifecycle report, `scene-contract.json` acceptance/performance sections, `verifier-inbox.md` provenance notes, and `integration-inbox.md` (hook decision only — **none published**). Source survey of `JourneyRuntimeProbeBridge.tsx`, `journeyRuntime.ts`, `autopilot/primitives.ts`, `AuditWorker.tsx`, `playerFrame.ts`, `cubeGravityConstants.ts`, `EfficientPlayer.tsx`, `commonGround*.ts` — all read-only.

**Reused the harness in place** (no replacement) + 3 pure modules + 1 offline runner:

1. **Per-frame provenance** — every screenshot brackets itself with its *own* cheap pre/post observation and records a **window**, its own hash/stats/role. Crossings mid-shutter ⇒ `atStateClaimable:false`, frame reported as *inside* a window, never a fake anchor instant. Raw/percept pairs always `simultaneous:false` with the real offset. Pixels/HUD-hiding preserved; `visualAcceptance` hard-false on every frame.
2. **Physical diagnostics** — found that `buildSnapshot()` has **no player pose at all** and that `entities` is a `Record`, not an array (the old probe's `Array.isArray` silently nulled every entity — fixed). Pose selection records source/precision/observed-quantum/capsule-centre frame, keeps the rounded `__autopilot.pos` as secondary, derives cylinder-bottom and sole with the `+Y` assumption flagged. CG diagnostics are **feature-detected from an allow-list** (no assumed name, no bridge edit, no mutating call — enforced by a test); absence recorded as *unavailable*. Path metrics labelled `measurement-lower-bound`, `isRuntimeProof:false`.
3. **Opt-in stall FAIL** (`--stall-fail-ms`, off by default) with exemptions for manual waits, genuinely-moving flight (a **parked** ship still fails — VF-DEEPLINK-1), actor motion, cue holds (delay, never cancel), out-of-scope phases. Fires ⇒ capture, graceful finalize, exit 3, **no rescue**. `outcome` vocabulary contains no success value; 10 s root-control polling intact.

**Tests:** 23/23 offline behavioural checks, plus a 5-mutant check (run on *copies*) proving they catch behaviour — shared-state collapse, pair simultaneity, cue-clock reset, blanket flight exemption, the entities bug — all detected.

## Honest limits worth flagging
- Nothing verifies current source; the Playwright wiring is **unexercised** offline, so IR-3 asks the next verifier for one short throwaway capture first.
- Full-precision pose and CG phase/cursor state remain **unobservable** until IR-1/IR-2 land; both are specified so no harness edit will be needed whatever name is chosen.

Deliverables: `harness-prep-report.json/md`, `harness-prep-progress.md`, logs under `verifier/logs/harness-prep/`. No game source, root-owned file, prior capture, or protected tool was touched; no git checkout/reset/restore.
